If the configuration parameter DemOBDEventDisplacement is set to FALSE the Dem module shall process the displacement without the OBD- behavior (refer to figure 7.29).

If the configuration parameter DemOBDEventDisplacement is set to FALSE, no special rules of displacement are applied to emission related events. In this case emission related events shall be displaced like every other event.
